rna_methods.analysis: Re-extraction of entire completed quantification matrices. No new alignment, differential expression, deconvolution or clinical classifier.
rna_methods.reference: 18 GSE50760 primary stageIV colorectal tumours; identical Salmon2.8.0/GENCODEv37/k31 index, separately prepared public libraries. Different laboratory/library preparation/treatment/site/purity remain confounding. Reference18 counts are not clinical percentiles.
rna_methods.primary_statistic: Unweighted arithmetic mean of gene log2(TPM+1), so no single high collagen TPM dominates a sum. Equal-weight median gene-wise log difference from18 reference medians reported as complementary robust effect.
rna_methods.rank_sensitivity: Mean within-sample average-tie expression ranks among a fixed GENCODEv37 coding-gene universe, compared with the same reference samples. Does not remove gene-length/library or cell-composition differences.
rna_methods.coding_sensitivity: Repeat using only protein_coding transcript TPM contributions while retaining each original whole-transcriptome normalisation denominator; no renormalisation or vendor matched coding percentile. Comparing total vs coding flags transcript allocation dependence.
rna_methods.leave_one_gene_out: Recompute mean-log ordering versus18 reference samples after dropping each individual set member. Range of counts lower reported. Not a sampling confidence interval.
rna_methods.gene_concordance: Count genes above reference75th/below25th, plus median gene differences. No t-tests/p-values or claims of pathway activation.
rna_methods.provider_summary: Within-set medians/counts of separately supplied BostonGene/Caris CRC percentiles are descriptive summaries, not a validated combined percentile or activity score. Caris selected panel has sparse coverage and cannot represent full modules.
rna_methods.bulk_limit: RNA conflates tumour, fibroblast, muscle, vascular and immune abundance. Myogenesis/smooth-muscle/epithelial/pericyte controls explore alternative composition; they do not estimate cell fractions.
rna_methods.no_Gut_classifier: The Gut CTHRC1CAF classifier is not reconstructed; published11-gene Dominguez set is distinct.
rna_methods.overlap: Modules overlap in genes and are not independent confirmations; full pairwise overlap table retained. Multiple displayed summaries do not multiply independent sample evidence.

protein_original_validation.baseline_reference_rank_reproduction: all four cohorts agree with prior analysis at strict 80% coverage

protein_limits: One historical mixed patient specimen, no biological replication or matched normal.
No raw-spectrum re-search, q-value reconstruction, clinical protein percentile, pSMAD/pFAK or spatial activity readout.
Curated panels are descriptive and include overlapping/opposing components; not validated pathway activation scores.
Komor reference runs are not independently verified donors; HPA3measurements represent one donor.
Non-detection and absence from a selected export do not establish biological absence.
Peptide specificity is scoped to the reviewed human reference; proteoforms, variants and raw spectral correctness remain unestablished.
